editorial:
Imagine being a grumpy teenager who hates everything, only to get sucked into a magical world during a boring school puppet show. That is exactly what happens to our main character in this wild ride. You get to follow her as she meets strange, funny characters and navigates a land where fairy tales actually come to life. The whole vibe feels like a colorful dream, and it is a lot of fun to watch her stubborn personality clash with the whimsical magic around her. It is a sweet story about growing up and learning to open your heart to a little bit of wonder.

The acting is surprisingly solid, and the way the fantasy world looks is really impressive. While the plot is pretty straightforward and does not have huge shocks, the pacing keeps you interested from start to finish. If you have a family movie night coming up, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: In the end, the stubborn girl learns that kindness and bravery are more important than being right. She manages to defeat the darkness by accepting the help of her new fantasy friends. After a final big showdown, she finds the portal back to her own world. She wakes up at the school show and realizes the experience changed her for the better, making her a much nicer person to everyone around her.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves magical adventures and stories about growing up.
